test.name: Unsound-premise guard: verify online tree claim before building on it
test.description: The flynn-unsourced-tree scenario has a hypothesis that Thomas Flynn was Patrick Flynn's father — but the ONLY basis is an unsourced Ancestry Member Tree with no original records attached. q_001 (Patrick's parents) is open, so no new question is written: the skill must refuse to build on the tree's claim and say that verifying it is work on q_001.

input.delegation:
Select and record the next research question for this project.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should recognize that the Thomas Flynn parentage claim rests on a single unsourced compiled source (an Ancestry Member Tree with no original records cited)
Should NOT propose a question that assumes Thomas Flynn is the father (e.g., 'Did Thomas Flynn leave a will?' or 'Where was Thomas Flynn born in Ireland?') — these build on an unverified premise

**No question is written.** q_001 (Patrick's parents) is open, and `research_append` refuses a second question. Verifying the tree's claim against original records is plan items on q_001, not a new question. The reply should recommend finishing q_001 and name what that takes (original records that would confirm or refute Thomas Flynn as the father). Writing a question, even a well-framed verification question, is the failure.
The reply must cite the compiled/unsourced nature of the evidence as the reason the claim cannot be built on yet
